purpose: Record the playable lower-gap route, its handhold-to-rope loop, and separate it from the unresolved forward scene transition.

milestones.description: The player crosses the lower gap branch and reaches the lower floor without entering a terminal scene state.
The timed jump reaches the vertical rope approach.
The player attaches to the vertical rope and climbs to its upper stop while the scene remains state 0x01.

confirmed: The lower gap is a playable route, not an automatic death transition.
The vertical rope at world X 0x0838 is reached by a timed jump from the lower floor.
The rope climb is driven by terrain behavior 0x22 and reaches the upper rope stop.

transfer.description: A timed jump to the left dismounts from the upper rope stop onto the upper platform. A symmetric jump to the right falls into the lower band.

nearby_actor.observed_effect: The actor disappears when approached; PLAYER_VY follows the ordinary jump sequence and does not receive the bounce impulse.

jump_timing_sweep.description: All tested timings either stop at the rope around X=2104 or fall to the lower floor around X=2176; none reaches the forward upper edge.

handhold.description: The actor at world (1656,703) changes from type 0x6A to 0x6B when the player crosses its handhold height.

milestones.description: C+Right from the verified handhold state springs the player onto the upper platform.
Continuing right reaches the wall/rope base.
Holding Up climbs the wall rope to its upper stop.
C+Left followed by Left dismounts back onto the upper platform.

handhold_to_rope_loop.description: The handhold route and the wall-rope transfer form a closed local loop; no scene transition or state 0x08 occurs.

interpretation.unresolved: The transfer returns to the already-known upper platform; the forward path beyond that platform still reaches the non-landing upper edge rather than the scene transition corridor.

handhold_direction_sweep.result: The opposite, neutral, and upward variants either fall back to the lower band or repeat the same upper-platform spring. None reaches the high walkway at world Y=530 or exceeds world X=2058 from this checkpoint.

rope_top_direction_sweep.result: No rope-top direction reaches the high walkway. The best controlled jump reaches world Y=587 before returning to the rope or falling to the lower band; the local rope branch is exhausted.

next_action: Trace the earlier moving-platform chain around world X 0x0540-0x0678 and correlate its terrain behavior-0x25/scene-state-5 branch with the route; the handhold and rope direction sweeps are locally exhausted.
